articles.summary: The storm flooded low-lying areas, knocked out power for thousands and forced the cancellation of several major events and hundreds of flights. Wind gusts exceeded 50 miles per hour in places.
articles.title: Nor’easter Live Updates: Heavy Rain and Wind Batter Northeast, Bringing Coastal Flooding

articles.summary: The White House TV pool went dark this past week amid a standoff between CNN and the president. Network leaders, however, believe an indefinite suspension may be untenable.
articles.title: TV Networks to Resume Trump Coverage, Even as White House Excludes CNN
